defaults.title: Use a lightweight browser compatibility baseline
defaults.statement: Unless the product context requires broader support, verify the POC in the latest stable Chrome release at one 390px mobile viewport and one 1280px desktop viewport.
defaults.rationale: This gives a consistent, low-cost responsive check for a non-production web POC.

defaults.title: Use proportionate automated and manual evidence
defaults.statement: Automate core domain, persistence, and critical interaction behavior, then manually walk through the approved acceptance criteria in the supported browser baseline.
defaults.rationale: The POC remains lightweight while preserving repeatable evidence for core behavior.

defaults.title: Use a qualitative POC performance boundary
defaults.statement: Unless the hypothesis depends on a measurable performance threshold, normal POC interactions must show no obvious lag during browser verification.
defaults.rationale: A numeric target should be elicited only when performance materially affects the product decision.
